# Clarity Chat by Code & Clarity
# https://codeclarity.ai

## About
Clarity Chat is a premium React component library for building AI chat interfaces. It provides production-ready, accessible components for integrating ChatGPT-quality conversational experiences into applications.

## Key Features
- Multi-provider support (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google)
- Token optimization with KV-cache alignment
- WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance
- TypeScript-first with full type safety
- React Server Components support
- Streaming support with SSE
- Semantic caching for cost reduction

## Target Users
- Frontend developers building AI chat features
- Engineering teams evaluating build-vs-buy decisions
- Product managers scoping AI integrations
- Enterprise architects requiring accessibility compliance

## Technology Stack
- React 19
- Next.js 15 App Router
- TypeScript (strict mode)
- Tailwind CSS
- Framer Motion
